en.content: The atomic hydrogen emits a line spectrum consisting of various series. Which series of hydrogen atomic spectra is lying in the visible region?
en.explanation: Balmer series of hydrogen atomic spectrum is lying in the visible region, when electron jumps from a higher energy level to n = 2 orbit.
